تستمعون (form VIII)
# تَسْتَمِعُونَ (tastamiʕūna) /tas.ta.mi.ʕuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَمَعَ (istamaʕa)
# تُسْتَمَعُونَ (tustamaʕūna) /tus.ta.ma.ʕuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَمَعَ (istamaʕa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
